stem: Ananya's class is discussing how sexual reproduction in humans passes on genetic information without the amount doubling in every generation. Which statement is not correct?

options.text: Each gamete carries half of a parent's genetic material.
A male gamete and a female gamete join during fertilisation.
Each child receives a complete set of genetic material from each parent.
The new cell formed at fertilisation contains a mix of information from both parents.

teacher.key_rationale: Gametes carry half the genetic material, so fertilisation restores (not doubles) the full amount while mixing information from two parents. Statement C claims each parent contributes a complete set, which would double the genetic material each generation; this is the incorrect statement, so C is the key.
